'''Dan Christy Chasm And Abyss Uniqueness Killer''' is a strategy article [[Dan Christy]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as Mystikal, under the title ''Chasm And Abyss: Uniqueness Killer''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/ChasmAndAbyss.htm Chasm And Abyss: Uniqueness Killer], The Outer Rim (Mystikal). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142129/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/ChasmAndAbyss.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Chasm And Abyss: Uniqueness Killer

Ever notice how sometimes
people show up to tournaments with decks including 5 Vaders, 4 Tarkins, or
3 Obi-Wan's? These decks insure that at least one copy will be down. So what
does that mean? There are more copies circulating in the deck to be drawn
as destiny. Now here's where Chasm or Abyss comes into play. Whenever a unique
card that is already in play on the table, the destiny is reduced to 0 and
lost. If it is a character, it loses immunity to attrition and you must lose
the character or 2 force. This is extremely useful in a number deck with Figrin
D'an. You bring up the insert cards fairly quickly plus your opponent is drawing
2 destiny and bringing up those unique characters. Make sure that your deck
won't be severely affected by this, as it affects both players. Try it out
and see if it fits your style. Good Luck.


Mystikal
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
